about: Draft 3 (DESIGN V19): the four product screens of the public film, drawn by code (src/scenes/screens.js) with made-up data for an Airbnb payments case: Ram owns host payout retries. Every name, team, channel, number and link is invented. A public build draws these in place of the slates; a private build still uses product.json and the real recordings. Times are seconds from the slot's start. The Peer's face is one picture, peer_face: swap that file and every screen follows.

reply.p2: Raising the retry limit for Brazil is Ram's call, so I haven't promised anything. It's in his morning brief.
